meta.title: Rostyslav Terletskyy — Software Developer
meta.description: Portfolio of Rostyslav Terletskyy, junior software developer with experience in web development (TypeScript, Three.js) and game programming (Unity, Unreal Engine).

hero.description: Junior software developer with hands-on experience in web development and game programming. Built a real-time 3D configurator and the business website presenting it during an internship, and developed several projects in Unity and Unreal Engine, including a multiplayer FPS. Learns new technologies quickly, with a focus on clean, maintainable code.

about.title: About Me
about.lead: Junior software developer who learns new technologies quickly and aims to get the most out of each tool and system, with care for the quality of the result.
about.p1: Started with IT studies in secondary school, then moved into game development, where building systems from scratch became the main interest. Built several projects in Unity and Unreal Engine, leading the team on Synced Rush and Alpha Exilemet.
about.p2: At Studio Evil, an internship that began as an evaluation of Three.js grew into a complete, scalable 3D product configurator and the business website presenting it. The most demanding technical work so far is the multiplayer system of Synced Rush: client–server communication, synchronization, latency compensation, and keeping physics consistent between players.
about.p3: Git is used on every project, and medium or large systems are documented so they stay easy to maintain and modify. Leading several projects has taught how to adapt communication to different people and find common ground, always clearly and directly. Current focus: designing the structure of systems to prevent future bugs and improve scalability.
about.languages: Italian (fluent), English (professional level, written and spoken)
about.interests: FPS and puzzle games, sport, building PCs
